name: Troll

source.note: The 2024 Troll (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). Loathsome Limbs is entered under the id troll_limbs (as text) so it is not read by the engine's older limb-severing code; its Troll Limb creature is a separate stat block not entered here. Charge is a special bonus action.

traits.name: Loathsome Limbs (4/Day)
traits.summary: If it ends a turn Bloodied after taking 15+ Slashing damage that turn, a limb is severed and becomes a Troll Limb; it has 1 Exhaustion level per missing limb and regrows them when next healed.
traits.text: If the troll ends any turn Bloodied and took 15 or more Slashing damage during that turn, one of its limbs is severed, falls in its space and becomes a Troll Limb (four times a day). The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 level of Exhaustion for each missing limb and grows replacement limbs the next time it regains Hit Points.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.summary: Regains 15 HP at the start of each of its turns; Acid or Fire damage stops that for its next turn. Dies only if it starts a turn at 0 HP and can't regenerate.
traits.text: The troll regains 15 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't work on its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

bonus_actions.name: Charge
bonus_actions.summary: Moves up to half its Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.

summary: A regenerating giant that rends three times a turn and can lose limbs that fight on.
